issue.title: Reconciliation job can double-post a correcting entry on retry
issue.body: If the nightly reconciliation job is retried after a partial failure, it can post the same correcting entry twice, changing account balances. Only seen once in staging, not confirmed in production, but the code path touches posting directly.
